descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S23 Vikram's Convex dashboard on the UAT deployment: the same rows, filtered and read without help

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 Everything above fires correctly and is queryable through Vikram's existing Convex dashboard access, with clearly named fields (not an unlabeled boolean or an internal enum only a dev would recognize … (UAT OAT-06 closing line; TFA-94514 AC 8; TFA-94609 AC 5; TFA-94609 AC 6)
  • U7 Per physician per day: notes generated, handoffs sent, and time from Pre-Round opened to note complete are aggregated and queryable in Convex (UAT OAT-06 Test 6; TFA-94514 AC 6)
  • T1 Engineering prepares a simple hand-off doc so Vikram knows how to access the analytics data (TFA-94514 AC 9)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The UAT (deployed) build after a QA physician has done S01, S07 and S15's steps; Vikram's or Tim's existing dashboard access

When Open Data -> pilotDailyRounding, filter userId and day; open pilotUsageEvents, patientActivityEvents, surveyResponses; follow the hand-off doc

Then Every event from the steps is there with the same values as the local run; notes generated, handoffs sent and the open-to-complete time for that physician and day can be read and the average worked out from the doc; no new UI or endpoint was needed

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 closing line; the reader confirms in writing. Done by Tim/Vikram, never by this agent (dev is out of bounds); Q12. An @roundai.test account only, never the store-review account; owner Tim

Where it ran: dev; test method CONFIG · Config check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: CONFIG · Config check; secondary: EXPLORATORY · Exploratory testing — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
